newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up ahead of USDA report.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up ahead of USDA report.

text.p: Trade on the European meals and feeds market picked up this afternoon ahead of Wednesday's USDA supply/demand figures, market sources said.
"Despite the stronger dollar some buyers thought it to be a good idea to cover positions ahead of tomorrow's USDA figures in case they prove to be bullish," one dealer said.

Afloat Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $291.50 a tonne cif Rotterdam and Jan shipment at $305.50 a tonne cif. Afloat Argentine soymeal pellets changed hands at $284.50 a tonne cif and March Dutch high protein soymeal fetched $311 a tonne fob Rotterdam.
Argentine sunmeal pellets came back from a strong fall last week and traded at $130 a tonne cif Rotterdam for Feb, March at $122, April/June at $120 and Aug/Oct at $124 a tonne cif Rotterdam.
Feb EU rapemeal traded at 30 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine, May/midJuly at 27.85 and Aug/Oct at 24 marks fob.
No trades were reported in other products.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
